messages:
Kevin: quick heatcheck — running the weekly bring-up/prioritization board now. want to lock gating decisions for next sprint. main items: nyx-30b bringup, ember-small 4-bit quant experiment, and a weird regression on lucen-13b.

Sasha: +1. can we do a fast triage on nyx? perf looks good but quality drops on instruction-follow. :thinking_face:

Maya: I ran the LH eval this morning, low-level note: nyx has a 7.2% drop on QA F1 vs baseline on dev set. will post exact diffs.

Oliver: Ember-small quant looks promising — 4-bit LUT path saved ~40% token-cost in staging. latency unchanged. need larger-quality sweep. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Tariq: lucen-13b regression is odd — only shows up on multi-turn summarization tests. could be prompt holdover / cache bug. I can reproduce locally.

Kevin: ok triage plan: 1) Sasha + Maya quick repro + targeted eval for nyx. 2) Oliver run quality sweep for ember quant (10k prompts). 3) Tariq debug lucen trace. assign owners?

Sasha: I can own nyx repro. will run targeted eval by EOD.

Maya: sending the eval diffs now. small snippet: ```
metric, baseline, nyx-30b
QA-F1, 0.842, 0.781
HELPFUL, 0.78, 0.74
```

Oliver: starting ember sweep. schedule: run overnight, will surface P95/P99 latency and avg BE token-cost.

eval-bot: automated-eval report for nyx-30b (targeted set):
- QA-F1 delta: -6.5%
- Hallucination score: +0.9
- Answer length distribution: +12% tokens

Tariq: lucen traces: found a case where KV-cache mismatch triggers fallback to non-streaming path, causing prompt truncation. minimal patch proposed.

Kevin: score rubric reminder for prioritization (quick calc):
```score = round(0.5*quality + 0.3*perf + 0.2*risk, 2)```
quality/perf/risk in [0..1]. fill in estimates for board.

Sasha: nyx estimates: quality=0.55, perf=0.9, risk=0.6 -> score ~0.67. recommend hold for deeper eval and regen with small LR-tune.

Oliver: ember-small quant estimates: quality=0.82, perf=0.95, risk=0.25 -> score ~0.86. recommend fast-track canary. :rocket:

Maya: lucen-13b after Tariq's patch likely quality back to baseline; risk low once patch lands. estimates: quality=0.78, perf=0.88, risk=0.35 -> score ~0.73

Kevin: consensus: ember quant canary next sprint, nyx on hold pending targeted finetune + eval, lucen patch runway for hotfix release. I'll update the triage board and add tickets.

Oliver: noted, I'll open canary run ticket and add monitoring hooks (latency/cost/qa checks).

Sasha: ticket for nyx eval request with eval set + prompts is here: https://go/redwood/issue/NYX-EVAL-142 :eyes:

Tariq: will land lucen patch in staging, request review from eng-runtime.

Kevin: thanks all. short follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 to confirm ember canary results. :thumbsup:

Maya: thx, will post nyx eval diffs when done.

eval-bot: scheduled ember-small 4-bit sweep started at 2134124200, ETA ~7h.

Oliver: perfect, ping me on results channel when complete.

Kevin: end of thread.
